description: Ministry of Sports - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No.1990/23 of 27.10.2016, adding ''68 French Savate''; a new sport
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order made under the Sports Act (No. 25 of 1973) by the Minister, which constitutes a regulatory matter.
